name: period-tracker
description: Period Tracker — free, private, local-first period & cycle tracking. Installable PWA.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name periodtracker
scripts.native:add:android: cap add android && cap sync android
scripts.native:add:ios: cap add ios && cap sync ios
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && cap open ios
